extracted.intended_audience: general readers and scholars of Renaissance satire / readers of Rabelais' Pantagruel
extracted.subtask_description: An excerpt from François Rabelais' Pantagruel (narrative chapters covering a storm at sea, island visits, comic discourse on heroic deaths, and a grotesque anatomical catalogue). Useful for studying Renaissance satire, bawdy/grotesque humor, and early-modern prose style.
